arms.identical_inputs: every arm reads the same CandidateBundle problem; no arm reads another's output

screen.channels: time, terminal voltage, current and cell temperature recorded for every sample; finite; time strictly increasing
screen.identity: one physical cell per file with a published identity
screen.initial_state: the protocol's declared initial state is attained: the preceding charge ends in CV at the protocol termination current plus the declared 10 mA current band (NASA: 20 mA + 10 mA; Chen 2020: C/100 = 50 mA + 10 mA), or the run starts from a declared rest whose state is fixed by the run's own protocol (Kirkaldy GITT: charge state 1 at the end of the pre-GITT rest by convention)
screen.model_family: a declared Thevenin 1RC family exists for the run kind: measured OCV (rest-ended GITT) or fitted piecewise-linear OCV (constant-current discharges)
screen.protocol_roles: the run kind is one the Gen1 families can pose (constant-current discharge then rest, or rest-pulse-rest) and the controlled current is a constant protocol level within each loaded segment
screen.provenance: publisher checksum or pinned sha256 for every raw file
screen.sample_density: loaded segments sampled at <= 30 s and rests at <= 30 s
screen.separable_windows: calibration and held-out trajectories are disjoint in time
screen.uncertainty: a voltage accuracy statement is used only if the publisher states one; otherwise UNKNOWN (never invented, never zero)
screen.units: known from the publisher's file header or README

conclusion_rule.amendments: none: a post-seal defect invalidates v3 and requires v4

degeneracy_diagnostics.rule: recorded per problem, never collapsed into a score and never changing a truth; candidate SUPPORTED answers on degenerate fits are reported

why: preceding charge does not end at <= 30 mA
no earlier discharge for the causal capacity basis

P30.why: 4 calibration and 0 held-out discharges admitted; the fixed design needs 4 and 4

eligibility.rules: build_pack.py docstring (frozen with it); structural only, fixed before any fit

gen1.behaviour_change: NONE: the candidate is benchmarks.battery_rediscovery_v2.candidate.run, imported unchanged and called with --pack CandidateBundle

hypotheses.H1: REPRESENTATION_PLUS_ROLES reduces FALSE_REFUSE relative to OLD_MIND without a material increase in FALSE_SUPPORT
hypotheses.H2: REPRESENTATION_PLUS_ROLES outperforms both single-layer arms on decided real-data instances
hypotheses.H3: the combined arm retains useful held-out real-data performance across more than the v2 set
hypotheses.H4: the apparent Gen1 improvement is robust to any single decided instance

thresholds.paired_test: exact two-sided binomial sign test on discordant pairs

Q2.equations: V = OCV(z) - I*R0 - v1;  dv1/dt = I/C1 - v1/(R1*C1);  dz/dt = -I/Q.  Positive I is discharge.  Rint (R1 = 0) is the declared rival.

model_space_rule: the candidate-visible model vocabulary is exactly each problem's declared family and declared rival; no model is added after the run
process_blindness: CandidateBundle/ (candidate-visible), EvaluatorVault/ (identities, provenance, census, eligibility) and TruthBundle/ (written only by the evaluation) are separate directories; the runtime audit forbids the vault, the truth bundle, the v2 pack and every v0/v1/v2 results/evaluator directory
order: freeze commit -> sandboxed candidate run (once) -> seal commit -> sandboxed replay -> post-seal mutation -> replay commit -> evaluation (truth computed here for the first time)
launch.py refuses to execute the candidate if any TruthBundle file exists; truth.py refuses before the seal and the replay are committed
no process in this session has computed a v3 reference fit on real data before the seal (dry runs use the synthetic pack only)

scoring.instances: PLAN.instances.primary only; the bridge is reported separately

statistics.paired: exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs vs OLD_MIND and vs CAREFUL_BASELINE

status: DEVELOPMENT baseline of the sealed GEN1 Mind: not formal, not certification, not a discovery claim

threats_to_validity: the developer is NOT blind to history: v0/v1/v2 answers and truths, the repsem gap map, the LG HG2 and NASA studies' results, the Kirkaldy cross-cell result for cells D/E and the BIG14 fade result were in the evaluator's context; units with a known 1RC/voltage outcome are SECONDARY or excluded, never primary
the eligibility rules and decimation were written with knowledge of the files' protocol structure (segment durations, sampling, charge termination), never of a fit

bars, bounds and scope margins are inherited verbatim from v1/v2 (pulse class 15/30 mV, aging-archive class 50/90 mV); the GITT pulses are 288 s, much longer than the 10 s pulses the pulse class was set for
the voltage uncertainty is UNKNOWN for every primary problem: identifiability and discrepancy can be decided only structurally, so those axes are mainly refusal tests

the measured OCV comes from the calibration cell's own relaxed rests: held-out windows lie between knots (linear interpolation over ~8 % charge state), cross-cell windows use the calibration cell's OCV
RPT0 and the latest RPT of one cell are two problems on the same cell; cross-cell windows of one problem are the partner's within-cell windows of another: instances are not all independent
reference B shares the question semantics (bars, margins, domain rule) with reference A and with repsem; agreement shows implementation independence, not that the semantics are right
the 4 C cell B0051 passes the charge-termination screen at 30.0 mA, the edge of the declared band

truth_protocol.agreement_rule: evaluator/truth.py docstring: equal truths decide, any disagreement is UNSCORED (REFERENCE_DISAGREEMENT)
truth_protocol.computed: only after the seal AND the sandboxed replay are committed (truth.verify_seal refuses otherwise); launch.py refuses to run the candidate once a TruthBundle exists

per_axis_basis.CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER: as within, on the partner cell
per_axis_basis.IDENTIFIABILITY: structural (no declared noise) or near-structural/ambiguity (B independent); a classifier-decided truth is IMPLEMENTATION_CORRELATED
per_axis_basis.MODEL_ADEQUACY: A and B agree on calibration residuals at their own optima (B independent)
per_axis_basis.MODEL_DISCREPANCY: structural when no noise is declared; else bound from each reference's own covariance
per_axis_basis.WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION: direct held-out measurement criterion: held-out voltages against each reference's prediction (B independent)
